relationships.subject: opto-iTrkA
relationships.evidence_quote: Opto-iTrkA activation also sensitizes the transient receptor potential vanilloid 1 (TRPV1) channel in cellular models

relationships.subject: opto-iTrkA
relationships.evidence_quote: Light illumination enables nontraumatic and reversible (<2 days) sensitization of mechanical pain in mice transduced with opto-iTrkA

key_findings: Blue-light opto-iTrkA activates ERK and Akt in DRG neurons, and axonal illumination drives pERK in the soma.
Opto-iTrkA repotentiates TRPV1 capsaicin responses and induces reversible mechanical sensitization in mice.
